description: HNB exchange rate for ONE foreign currency vs EUR (Croatia is in the eurozone). Pass the 3-letter ISO currency code (e.g. "USD", "GBP", "CHF"). Three modes: omit dates for the latest rate; pass `date` for a single historical date; pass `start_date`+`end_date` for a daily time series over that window. srednji_tecaj is the middle/reference rate. Rate values are strings with a COMMA decimal separator (e.g. "1,164900"). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

date.description: Single historical date, YYYY-MM-DD. Ignored if start_date is given.

end_date.description: Time-series window end, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when start_date is given.

name: hnb_currency_rate
title: Hnb Currency Rate
